screen.title: New post
screen.subtitle: Write it once, then adjust how it goes out on each platform.

text.hashtagsHint: Press Enter to add. Separate several with commas.

timing.pastTime: That moment has already passed, so the post goes out right away.
timing.nativePlan: {{platform}} schedules it on its side. You can close the tab.
timing.serverPlan: AnycastStudio publishes it at that moment. You can close the tab.

video.formats: MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI or MKV.
video.resumeHint: {{done}} of {{total}} MB already reached the server. Choose the same file to carry on.
video.resumeMismatch: That is a different file. Choose the one the upload started with.

error.payload_too_large: That file is larger than your per-file limit.
error.quota_exceeded: Not enough storage left. Delete something first.
error.conflict: Too many uploads at once. Wait for one to finish.
error.invalid: The upload did not arrive intact. Try again.
error.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.

platformTab.publishToHint: Include {{platform}} when you press Publish. Toggle with {{shortcut}}.
platformTab.connectHint: Connect your {{platform}} account to turn this on.

summary.title: Summary
summary.immediate: Goes out as soon as you publish
summary.needsPlatform: Turn on at least one platform in its tab.
summary.unavailable: Publishing moves to the server in the next step.
